Subject: Multiparametric MRI of the Prostate | Date: 05 Feb 2025 | Department: Imaging, Maastricht UMC+

Clinical context: Re-evaluation for previously diagnosed prostate malignancy. Current PSA stands at 11.7 ng/mL, with a PI-RADS 4 designation on earlier scans.

FINDINGS:
Total glandular volume registers at 41.58 mL. T2-weighted sequences highlight a discrete hypointense focus in the right mid-gland peripheral zone, measuring roughly 12 × 9 × 10 mm. Restricted diffusion is evident on DWI, mirrored by low ADC signal. DCE sequences show early, focal enhancement compared to adjacent tissue. Capsular integrity holds; neurovascular bundles remain untouched. No seminal vesicle invasion, extraprostatic spread, or suspicious nodal enlargement.

IMPRESSION:
Focal lesion in the right mid-gland peripheral zone consistent with PI-RADS 4.
Prostate volume 41.58 mL; PSA density 0.281 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.6642831.
